description: This file implements a text-based menu box component, likely used within a dialog or menu system in a Linux-based project. It handles rendering menu items, navigation, scrolling, and user interaction within a terminal interface.

methods.name: void do_print_item(WINDOW * win,const char * item,int line_y,int selected,int hotkey)
methods.description: Prints a single menu item within the menu window, highlighting if selected and displaying hotkeys.

methods.name: void print_arrows(WINDOW * win,int item_no,int scroll,int y,int x,int height)
methods.description: Displays scroll indicators (up and down arrows) if applicable.

methods.name: void print_buttons(WINDOW * win,int height,int width,int selected)
methods.description: Displays control buttons like 'Select', 'Exit', 'Help' within the dialog.

methods.name: void do_scroll(WINDOW * win,int * scroll,int n)
methods.description: Performs scrolling of the menu window by a specified number of lines.

methods.name: int dialog_menu(const char * title,const char * prompt,const void * selected,int * s_scroll)
methods.description: Main function for displaying a menu dialog, handling user input, navigation, scrolling, and returning the user's choice.
